legacy.interpretation: All 41 actual paletted phases inspected: progressive reveal and feature highlighting of a fixed view, not operating motion. All profile catalogue roles map to AC09.VID. Shared ACS3 scaffolding remains separate; _MA has no AC-named family. Function1020 establishes trade and visiting as the facility role; no hidden trading interiors invented.

concept_attempts.feedback: Retains the compact multi-lobed hall, two low blue-window pavilions, two supported higher side chambers with short posts, upper circular coral motif, paired warm fields and slate crown. Accepted with source-led corrections: shorten the top and preserve the cross-shaped warm fields rather than treating the concept four-pane grids as authoritative. No invented stalls, interiors or machinery.

glb_feedback.observation: Actual first native/import renders preserve the lobe hierarchy and front fields, but the top is too tall/pointed, the circular roof motif reads as a shield, and the central dark recess reflects too much light.
glb_feedback.action: Shortened the crown neck/hood and side posts, reduced recess specularity and attempted a smoother analytic outline for the coral motif. Updated the explicit model-height constraint from observed source proportions, not merely to pass export checks.

glb_feedback.observation: Revised real render improves crown/recess, but angular-profile interpolation still produces a tapered roof motif.
glb_feedback.action: Replaced only that casting with a closed circular patch projected onto the actual cut hall mesh by ray casting. Added a projected-radius error check and 48 distinct boundary directions on both source and independent import. This also reduces exported triangles.

glb_feedback.observation: Final real front-quarter/front/rear imports and native pairs reviewed: shorter slate crown, circular seated motif, deep central recess, two warm crosses, blue portholes and supported side chambers remain clear.
glb_feedback.action: Accept for integration review, with quiet interpreted rear surfaces. Constant low warm/blue emission does not establish an operating or blink cycle. Final user artistic acceptance and client scale/state/FPS remain separate.

review: Legacy-led static trade/visiting facility with curved coral chambers, two real blue portholes, cross-shaped warm glazing and a small slate crown. Actual source/import support and owner-specific field checks, projected circular surface casting, sparse seams and restrained wear. Rear/corridor continuation is interpreted; approximate review camera, no numerical legacy-fidelity score. Same rooted canonical payload for gameplay/build/SciTek.
